evidence.quote: Market adjustments since May have been larger than would be justified by any reasonable reassessment of the path of policy.
If the Committee's economic outlook is broadly realized, there will likely be a moderation in the pace of purchases later this year.
Continued low or falling inflation could, however, raise real concerns. Inflation can be too low as well as too high.
But we are still far from full employment. The case for continued support for the economy from monetary policy is strong.
In my view, there has been real progress in the labor market.
With inflation in check, the most important potential risk, in my view, is that of financial instability.

parsed.rationale: The speaker endorses a data-dependent taper later this year but strongly pushes back against market pricing of early rate hikes, stresses below-target inflation and distance from full employment. Net signal leans modestly dovish relative to market expectations despite the taper endorsement.
